name: copilotx-chat
description: A VS Code extension and Codex-style PowerShell CLI for multi-agent coding with local and hosted LLM providers.

copilotx.provider.description: LLM provider. 'none' uses the offline deterministic engine; 'local' uses an OpenAI-compatible server on http://127.0.0.1:8082/v1; 'nim' uses NVIDIA NIM's OpenAI-compatible API.

copilotx.apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. Prefer storing it with the 'CopilotX: Store API Key' command (SecretStorage) or in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment.

copilotx.openaiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. For NVIDIA NIM, use https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 or your local NIM URL.

copilotx.includeWorkspace.description: Attach active file, selection, open tabs, and project tree to every chat turn.

copilotx.allowWrites.description: File-edit tools. 'off' hides write tools from the model; 'approval' shows a diff you must Accept; 'auto' applies changes immediately and opens the diff.

copilotx.streamResponses.description: Stream assistant responses token-by-token in the sidebar (live providers).

copilotx.inlineCompletions.description: Enable Copilot-style ghost-text completions while typing. Requires a live provider (provider != none) with a valid API key.

copilotx.pipeline.enabled.description: Enable the multi-agent pipeline; requests routed to the Pipeline agent get a supervisor plan, parallel workers, and QC verification.

copilotx.pipeline.maxWorkers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker tasks the pipeline runs per plan.

copilotx.pipeline.maxQcRounds.description: Maximum QC fix-loop rounds per worker task before escalation.

copilotx.pipeline.supervisorModel.description: Optional model override for the supervisor pipeline role; empty inherits copilotx.model.

copilotx.pipeline.workerModel.description: Optional model override for the worker pipeline role; empty inherits copilotx.model.

copilotx.pipeline.qcModel.description: Optional model override for the QC pipeline role; empty inherits copilotx.model.

chatParticipants.name: copilotx
chatParticipants.description: Multi-agent coding assistant (Ask / Explore / Plan / Custom)
